parameters.name: BackupPeriod
parameters.description:
The backup cycle. You must specify at least 2 days. The value is a 7-digit number. From left to right, each digit represents whether backup is enabled from Monday to Sunday. A value of 0 indicates that backup is disabled, and a value of 1 indicates that backup is enabled:

- First digit: Monday
- Second digit: Tuesday
- Third digit: Wednesday
- Fourth digit: Thursday
- Fifth digit: Friday
- Sixth digit: Saturday
- Seventh digit: Sunday

parameters.name: BackupPlanBegin
parameters.description: The daily backup start time in UTC.

parameters.name: BackupSetRetention
parameters.description: The retention period of backup sets. Unit: days.

parameters.name: BackupType
parameters.description: The backup type. Currently, only "0" is supported, which indicates fast backup.

parameters.name: BackupWay
parameters.description:
The backup method. Valid values:

- **P**: physical backup.
- **L**: logical backup.

parameters.name: ColdDataBackupInterval
parameters.description: The interval of cold data backups. Unit: days. Valid values: 1 to 59.

parameters.name: ColdDataBackupRetention
parameters.description: The retention period of cold data backups. Unit: days. Valid values: 30 to 730.

parameters.name: CrossRegionDataBackupRetention
parameters.description: The retention period of cross-region data backups. Unit: days.

parameters.name: CrossRegionLogBackupRetention
parameters.description: The retention period of cross-region log backups. Unit: days.

parameters.name: DBInstanceName
parameters.description: The instance ID.

parameters.name: DestCrossRegion
parameters.description: The destination region for cross-region backup.

parameters.name: ForceCleanOnHighSpaceUsage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcibly clean up binary logs when the total space usage of the instance exceeds 80% or the remaining space is less than 50 GB. The cleanup starts from the earliest logs until the total space usage drops below 80% and the remaining space exceeds 50 GB. Valid values:

- **1**: Yes.
- **0**: No.

parameters.name: IsCrossRegionDataBackupEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable cross-region data backup. Default value: false.

parameters.name: IsCrossRegionLogBackupEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable cross-region log backup. Default value: false.

parameters.name: IsEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable backup. The value is fixed to 1, which indicates that backup is enabled.

parameters.name: LocalLogRetention
parameters.description: The number of hours that log backups are retained locally. Valid values: 0 to 168 (7 × 24 hours). A value of 0 indicates that log backups are not retained locally. Default value: 7.

parameters.name: LocalLogRetentionNumber
parameters.description: The number of local binary logs to retain. Default value: 60. Valid values: 6 to 100.

parameters.name: LogLocalRetentionSpace
parameters.description: The maximum binary log space usage in percentage. Valid values: 0 to 50. This parameter specifies a loop space. Default value: 30.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: RemoveLogRetention
parameters.description: The number of days that log backups are retained remotely. Valid values: 7 to 730. Unit: days. Default value: 7.
